svg.title: Hodge v1.1.0 · Figure 2 · Clay Cannot Stay Open: Closed By Theorem To One Bit
svg.text: FIGURE 2
CLAY CANNOT STAY OPEN: CLOSED BY THEOREM TO ONE BIT
HODGE · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
THE OPEN FRAMING: FOUR COUNTS, EACH REFUTED BY THEOREM
COUNT I
No proof from shared resources
No keyless premise forces the value, and existence as given forces nothing: no
given statement is the value on every frame, and the arrow forces nothing.

svg.text: COUNT II
No decision from the record
The record of classes and codimensions is shared by both worlds, its fibre infinite
and its bit two; no finite record forces the value.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: COUNT III
No route past the bit
No premise reaches the Hodge sentence while the bit fails: every route passes
the bit, in any vocabulary, and delivers both kinds.

svg.text: COUNT IV
What remains is the bit
Its antecedent proved with no hypothesis, the bit proved equivalent to the
sentence at every host: the question is one implication, and it is keyed.

svg.text: THE STATUS OF THE QUESTION · THREE COLUMNS, ONE VERDICT
UNQUALIFIED OPEN
The framing that leaves the question open
with no form fixed and no referent for open.
Each of its four counts is refuted by theorem.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: CLOSED BY THEOREM
The Hodge sentence is the bit and its denial
the bit's denial; every keyless route is barred;
the twelve formal gates run in the kernel.

svg.text: DELIVERED TWICE
The bit supplied by the act at premise grade
and delivered by the formal cargo and by the
physical witness; one class without its cycle
refutes both.

svg.text: The Hodge question cannot stay open. It is closed by theorem to one bit, and the bit is delivered
twice by the act.
Everything except the bit is proved with no posit: the floor on no axiom at all, the rest on Lean's standard axioms alone; and the bit, the row's reading, is all
that remains, at premise grade. In this paper every theorem of the master stands on no axiom at all.
